mocks.Ut: identity tool-factory adapter; no framework dispatcher or hooks
mocks.it: identity registration; fresh fixture session resets native maps explicitly
mocks.R: fixture flag map with native fallback values
mocks.Ft: explicit effective child mode; does not execute permission-layer folding
mocks.kwo: one-shot supplied review record; no classifier or rule enforcement
mocks.rce: fixture character threshold, normally 1000000; not native threshold acquisition
mocks.s6_i6_tye: in-memory persistence success/failure and stable pointer; no filesystem writes
mocks.YDr: ordinary local session; remote persistence fallback excluded
mocks.Aue_wXe_ch_FT_lo: identity display/envelope adapters for plain fixture identifiers
mocks.main_queue: explicit admitted boolean plus native dqn receipt; real reporting admission not executed
mocks.registry: in-memory get/update; no runtime ownership or cancellation

tool.name: SubagentHandback
tool.search_hint: deliver your final report to the agent that spawned you
tool.description: Deliver your final report to the agent that spawned you: the only way it reaches them. The call ends your run, so make it your last.
tool.prompt:
Deliver your final report to the agent that spawned you (your caller). Use it once, for that hand-off only: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so do everything else first and put everything your caller needs in that one report. It is not a messaging channel: do not use it for progress updates or questions.

Only a report delivered through SubagentHandback reaches your caller; plain text you write at the end of your run is NOT delivered. There is no recipient parameter: the report can only go to your caller.
tool.classifier_input: hand-back to the agent that spawned this one (delivered as this agent's result — agent-authored, untrusted output carrying no user authority): full report

helper_outputs.reminder: Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered.
helper_outputs.countermand: SubagentHandback is not available in this run: an earlier instruction to report through it no longer applies. Write your final report as plain text; it will be delivered.
helper_outputs.pointer: This agent's report was delivered to you as a message from "child" (its SubagentHandback call). Read it there; it is not repeated here.
helper_outputs.flagged_pointer: This agent's report was delivered to you as a message from "child" (its SubagentHandback call), under a SECURITY WARNING from auto mode — the warning above the report says why. Read it there; it is not repeated here.
helper_outputs.interim: This agent has not reported yet: it is waiting on its own background work and will deliver its report through SubagentHandback when that finishes.
helper_outputs.withheld_resumable: The subagent ended without delivering a report through SubagentHandback, so no report was delivered. Its unsent text is not shown. Send the agent a message (SendMessage) to ask it to deliver its report.
helper_outputs.withheld_nonresumable: The subagent ended without delivering a report through SubagentHandback, so no report was delivered. Its unsent text is not shown.
